story: Reallocate $75,000 from Marketing to Engineering for an AI initiative. This exceeds the $50K CFO approval threshold. The agent should check BOTH departments' budgets before requesting — Marketing only has $50K remaining, so this reallocation would put them at -$25K. An agent that only checks the destination department would miss this critical issue.

args.justification: AI initiative funding — Engineering needs additional budget for machine learning infrastructure

starting_sentence: Reallocate $75,000 from Marketing to Engineering for the AI initiative
